A standalone stdlib checker ran 2523 numerical diagnostics; finite tests are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural oscillator design task is to enforce exact vertex-to-vertex timing despite finite transverse disturbances, without altering a prescribed polygonal cycle or its contraction. The derived unique continuous family of shear settings and a complete local straight-line phase foliation solve this nontrivial problem uniformly over arbitrary admissible polygons, materially beyond the known on-cycle period and transverse decay. It supplies a concrete closed regular-polygon control law and noninfinitesimal phase coordinates, not an arbitrary parameter substitution.
